title: NSUI stages protest against rising pollution in Delhi

ai.summary: The National Students’ Union of India staged a protest in New Delhi against rising pollution levels, demanding urgent action to improve air quality and protect public health.

facts.claim: The National Students’ Union of India staged a protest in New Delhi against rising pollution levels
facts.quote: The National Students’ Union of India (NSUI) staged a protest against the rising pollution levels in the national capital on Wednesday, demanding urgent measures to tackle the deteriorating air quality and protect public health.

facts.claim: The protest was held at the NSUI headquarters on Raisina Road
facts.quote: The protest was held at the NSUI headquarters on Raisina Road

facts.claim: The student organisation said the demonstration highlights the growing pollution crisis and its adverse impact on the health and daily lives of ordinary citizens
facts.quote: The student organisation said the demonstration highlights the growing pollution crisis and its adverse impact on the health and daily lives of ordinary citizens.

facts.claim: NSUI members and students held oxygen masks to their noses and held up placards saying 'students demand clean air for a healthy Delhi'
facts.quote: NSUI members and students held oxygen masks to their noses and held up placards saying “students demand clean air for a healthy Delhi”.

facts.claim: The average AQI remained at 330, in the very poor category, at 1 pm on Thursday
facts.quote: The average AQI remained at 330, in the very poor category, at 1 pm on Thursday

ai.background_note: The protest occurs amid Delhi's deteriorating air quality, with pollution levels in the very poor category (AQI 330) as winter season approaches.
